messages:
Anika: Heads-up scheduling a config-only tweak in the late change window (2026-02-03 02:00 UTC). Changes: tenant concurrency 9->6, soft timeout 13s->10s, move 5% traffic to low-latency pool (us-west-2), max_batch_tokens 400->280. No model updates.
Tom: Fine with that. Any pins?
Anika: Pinning metrics-collector and research-qa for first 25m. Canary size 0.5%.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued by Anika. Job 90221. Canary targets: gw-usw2-canary x3.
Renee: Observability prep done: latency dashboards, cost tag, and per-route tracing enabled. Link: https://console.redwood.example/d/ops/mini-rollout
Omar: Rollback criteria: p95 >25% increase for 10m OR error-rate +0.5% for 5m OR KV eviction spike >12%. Also cost bump >18%/1h triggers staged rollback to previous batching.
deploy-bot: Canary started -> applying routing & batching patch to canary pool.
Anika: Canary applied. Initial p50/p95 steady.
Renee: KV hit dropped 91->88% but latency flat. Tracing shows extra rehydration calls due to smaller batches.
Tom: If tails increase, prefer TTL bump to avoid full rollback. Keep canary scoped.
Anika: Agreed. Proceed to 10% staged after 20m if stable.
deploy-bot: Staged to 10% -> job 90221-staged.
Renee: At 10% p95 shows small +7% on long-chat routes but within threshold. No cost spike.
Anika: Proceed to 40% but keep pinned tenants excluded until 60m.
deploy-bot: Expanding to 40% -> job 90221-staged-2. Holding for 45m observation.
Omar: I'll standby for rollback commands. If needed: `deployctl rollback 90221` (full) or `deployctl set-weights --rollback-only 90221` (routing only).
Tom: Drafting short release note to call out transient tail latency for long chats and contact for eng-oncall.
Anika: Published note. If all clear after hold, we'll continue rollout; otherwise revert routing weights first. :thumbsup:
